content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Stripe and Gumroad offer convenience—until they don’t. Stripe locks out entire countries, and Gumroad delays payouts for weeks. NOWPayments with Cloudflare Workers offers sovereignty. You deploy your own stack, own the code, and control the flow. No platform fees beyond NOWPayments’ 0.5%. No subscriptions. No third-party dependencies. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, Supabase stores orders, and GitHub Pages hosts your storefront. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this in 48 hours, fully configured and tested. Choose renting convenience or owning infrastructure.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal block creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya. Gumroad works but delays payouts indefinitely. NOWPayments operates globally, no restrictions. USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction, Solana fractions of a cent. Cloudflare Workers and Supabase don’t care where you’re based. Your stack runs on decentralized networks. Convert crypto to local currency via P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. Infrastructure sovereignty bypasses geographic lockout. You’re not asking permission—you’re building your own system.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad holds payouts for weeks. Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. NOWPayments charges 0.5% with no KYC. USDT on Tron settles in minutes for under $0.10. Solana transactions cost pennies. Cloudflare Workers and Supabase cost nothing for small-scale use. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email config, ensuring delivery. Total cost: $197 plus 0.5% per transaction. Compare that to Gumroad’s 10% fee and Stripe’s country blocks. Speed, cost, and control—NOWPayments wins.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Stripe or Gumroad, you rent. With NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you own. Deploy once, own forever. Webhooks automate order fulfillment—payment confirms, product delivers. No manual intervention. Supabase stores order data, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) loads 5 products, configures email, and tests end-to-end before handoff. You get lifetime access, no subscriptions. Your stack runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—free, global, unstoppable. Ownership is non-negotiable.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a Stripe-blocked country, NOWPayments with Cloudflare Workers is your only real option. If you’re tired of Gumroad’s delays, this stack automates payouts and delivery. If you sell digital products and want to own your infrastructure, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys in 48 hours. If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya, convert USDT or SOL to local currency via P2P exchanges. Choose based on sovereignty, not convenience. Rent or own—the choice is infrastructure-defining.
